description: This file defines the class 'PendingAppraisalReviewSummary' within the OrangeHRM Dashboard module. It generates summaries of pending appraisal reviews for employees, based on certain workflow states, by interfacing with external services and data access objects.

classes.name: PendingAppraisalReviewSummary
classes.description: A class that summarizes pending appraisal reviews for a specific employee, providing methods to retrieve group ID, group name, and pending review count.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the review search filters with the employee number and specific review statuses.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the numerical identifier for the group category.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the descriptive name of the group.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of pending appraisal reviews matching the search criteria.
